name: @pronghorn/e2e
description: Playwright regression harness shared by app/frontend (legacy) and app/frontend-new (spec 007).

scripts.test:legacy: rm -f baselines/axe-legacy.raw.jsonl && APP=legacy BASE_URL=${BASE_URL:-http://localhost:${FE_PORT:-8140}} playwright test regression && node scripts/build-axe-baseline.mjs
scripts.test:new: rm -f baselines/axe-legacy.raw.jsonl && APP=new BASE_URL=${BASE_URL:-http://localhost:${FE_PORT:-8141}} playwright test regression shell
